name: VOLUNTEERS ONLY SFX Library_v1
revision: rev3 (2026-10-07): rev1 review fixed (rev2) plus a comedy pass on voices and head hits; same file names as rev1 (the 24 Mixkit files are exactly the ones in .gitignore), plus operation_heartbeat_03-04 and operation_rip_04-05
approved_list: Download list approved by Fedya on 2026-10-06; nothing outside it was used.
format: WAV PCM 16-bit, 48 kHz, TPDF dither. One-shots mono; ambience loops stereo except the fountains (mono point sources); siren loop mono.
naming: <category>/<id>_NN.wav, id = SfxLibrary event id (SfxIds) or a suggested new id (id_in_SfxIds = false).

processing.declipping: sources with flat tops (full-scale runs, or runs at a lower level) are rebuilt with a cubic spline at their native rate before anything else, where the spline gives a plausible peak (1-1.6x the flat top); see sources[].declipped. The three slaps with flattened tops are not used.
processing.one_shots: high-pass (30-80 Hz by category), trim to the transient (1-12 ms pre-roll) plus its natural decay, 1.5 ms fade-in, 50-100 ms fade-out; when a length cap applies, the cut goes to the deepest envelope dip before it. level_at_cut_db is how loud the source still was where it was cut (all <= -30 dB re. peak). Kenney UI/tick files and the bounded sob phrase are not trimmed. A final 20 Hz high-pass (more for 20-140 ms ticks and the heartbeat) removes low-frequency offset.
processing.loudness: matched inside a match group on the max short-term K-weighted loudness (window: 150 ms footsteps, 100 ms hits/operation/ui, 200 ms doors/police, 400 ms voices). Group target = a percentile of what each clip reaches at -1 dBTP, capped so that the peakiest clip gets there with at most 2-3.5 dB of limiting; the limiter works on the 4x-oversampled true peak, so every file is at or under -1 dBTP. Slaps are their own group (balance against punches with the library volume).
processing.footsteps: NOX takes on every surface (asphalt = NOX rock/tile walk; metal = NOX metal walk/single-strike takes; sand = NOX sand walk/run, gravel). Grass starts 6 ms before its main rustle peak (4 ms fade-in). Each take must pass the review's step test: no second hit within 12 dB of the main one, main hit <= 15 ms after the onset (sand, walked heel-to-toe: 10 dB / 25 ms; onset lands at 0-5 ms), natural decay; one variant per source take. A tail expander (after the main hit only) pulls the boosted noise floor of grass and sand down. Fixed 150 ms targets: asphalt -22, metal -25, grass -24, sand -24 LUFS (asphalt, the default surface, 2 dB over grass and sand). EQ: asphalt +3 dB above 2 kHz and -2 dB below 120 Hz, metal +2.5 dB above 2.5 kHz, grass -3 dB below 150 Hz.
processing.loops: seam made by crossfading the head with the continuation after the loop end (equal power for ambience, linear for the phase-aligned siren), no fades at the seam. Ambience: recurring events that stick out (50 ms level more than 5 dB over the 2 s running median, or >2.5 kHz clacks more than 12 dB over theirs) are ducked loop-safely (see loop_info.ducked_events), the birds are L/R balanced, every bed is -26 LUFS integrated with no limiting. The siren is normalised to -1 dBTP; its AudioSource volume sets the level.
processing.comedy_pass: 2026-10-07, Fedya: sounds must be dumb and funny like the game, but not too dumb. npc_scream = the two Mixkit falling screams + NOX 'Hit' exclamations, two of them with a late falling pitch glide (-3/-4 st varispeed); no NOX 'Pain' cries. npc_whimper = Mixkit creature sobs (cut at >= 30 dB gaps) + sighs + soft whimpers, no sobbing breaths. npc_gasp = NOX 'Surprise' ('oh!/huh?!'). npc_mumble adds throat clearing. npc_hurt = 'ai!/oof' and landing grunts. hit_head: every hit has a wooden 'bonk' 1 dB under the punch; the pan bong (05) and the boing (08) are the rare cartoon variants. Voice pitch in the library: about 1.0-1.12.
processing.selection: no listening: chosen from file names, the NOX folder structure and signal analysis (RMS, peaks, noise floor, onset detection, step events, spectral centroid, autocorrelation pitch, cross-correlation against every related clip: no pair of related clips correlates above 0.87).

blocked_sources: Pixabay: all 13 approved pages returned a Cloudflare check (HTTP 403); nothing from Pixabay is used. Missing because of it: gibberish voices (crowd/radio), frying-pan hit, handcuffs, fountain, waves-with-gulls #2, heart-monitor beep, wood saw, van rear doors, car braking, fake crying, cooler, cartoon angry woman scream.
restricted_files_note: 24 files with restricted_redistribution = true contain Mixkit audio (Mixkit Sound Effects Free License, https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree): allowed inside the game, NOT allowed to be redistributed as standalone files or as a sound pack. github.com/FEDCHER67/Game is public: committing these WAVs publishes them. They are listed in the repository .gitignore (with their .meta files).
